definitions.F: canonical nonterminal residual after unit propagation has reached a fixed point
definitions.n: number of live underlying Boolean variables in F
definitions.T: maximum cooccurrence frequency of any nondegenerate sign-aware unordered literal pair in F
definitions.d_x: number of clauses containing x or -x
definitions.A_x: sum over clauses containing x or -x of (|C|-1), equivalently the total pair-incidence mass touching underlying variable x

local_raw_bound.statement: For a live pivot x, let p/q be the positive/negative bucket counts and A_P/A_Q the corresponding sums of (|C|-1). Before tautology, duplicate and subsumption cleanup, Davis-Putnam elimination has raw state_units R_x = s + p*q + (q-1)A_P + (p-1)A_Q - 2(p+q). Hence R_x <= s + d_x^2/4 + (d_x-1)A_x - 2d_x.
proof: The retained part contributes exactly the original state after removing the p+q pivot clauses and their literals.
There are at most p*q resolvent clauses in the raw multiset.
Across all p*q parent pairs, nonpivot literal occurrences contribute q*A_P+p*A_Q.
Subtracting the removed pivot-clause contribution yields R_x = s+p*q+(q-1)A_P+(p-1)A_Q-2(p+q).
AM-GM gives p*q <= (p+q)^2/4=d_x^2/4, and both q-1 and p-1 are <=d_x-1.

pair_dispersion_lemma.statement: At a unit-propagation fixed point, every live pivot x satisfies d_x<=A_x<=4(n-1)T. Therefore every pivot raw output satisfies R_x <= s+20(n-1)^2*T^2. In particular, if s+20(n-1)^2*T^2 <= N^2, frozen ordinary exact elimination is guaranteed to admit the first canonical live pivot under the N^2 cap.
proof: No unit clause remains, so every pivot-clause has at least one nonpivot literal; hence d_x<=A_x.
For each other underlying variable y there are at most four sign-aware pair types between x and y. With n-1 choices of y and per-type frequency at most T, A_x<=4(n-1)T.
Using d_x<=A_x in the local bound gives R_x<=s+A_x^2/4+A_x^2 <= s+(5/4)A_x^2.
The implementation's monotone raw set can only be smaller than this multiset bound because tautologies and duplicates are discarded; optional canonical subsumption only decreases size further.
Therefore the cap cannot be crossed when the stated inequality holds.

facts: If s<=2N-1, TWO_N_MINUS_ONE_ELIMINATION_CORRIDOR guarantees every pivot fits.
If T>=s-2N+11 and roots remain live, FREQUENT_PAIR_FORCES_V2_ROOT_RESCUE guarantees a v2 move.
If s+20(n-1)^2*T^2<=N^2, ordinary elimination is guaranteed to fit even when s>=2N.

interpretation: The unresolved root-phase region is no longer generic high volume. A witness must simultaneously have enough distributed local pair pressure to defeat the raw-elimination bound while avoiding enough concentration in any one pair to trigger the proved v2 rescue threshold.
next_exact_target: Search the frozen reachable trajectory specifically for BALANCED_PAIR_PRESSURE_ROOT_WEDGE states. A reachable witness refutes current root-phase totality; absence in finite probes is not proof. In parallel, seek a combinatorial contradiction between all-pivot monotone-cap overflow and pair dispersion on reachable states.
